Pure code, this lane's; not a governed surface.

## What the ruling says

`check-ratchet-remedy-authority` (the #8435 detector) walks `scripts/` NON-RECURSIVELY (`corpusFiles()`, a `readdirSync` admitted by extension — `check-ratchet-remedy-authority.mjs:43` and `:242`), so the 14 gates under `scripts/pm/*.mjs` — including the per-file line ratchet the 2026-09-03 cross-file-move exception amends — have never been in its sweep; a self-test assertion (PR #14860) pins the non-recursive walk so that a wider walk reds there and makes the widening a decision someone takes.

- **Step 1 — measure**: in a throwaway worktree, widen the walk to `scripts/pm/**` and produce the roster of hits (every `scripts/pm/*.mjs` whose author-facing text offers a registry-growing remedy without the `⛔ MAINTAINER-ONLY` token or an outright refusal), with the verdict class each lands in.
- **Step 2 — one PR**: add `scripts/pm/` to the scan and bring every hit under the convention (mark the expanding remedy `⛔ MAINTAINER-ONLY`, or refuse it outright — never push a refusing gate onto the marking shape); update the self-test that reds on a widened scan in the same PR so the widening is the explicit decision it was built to force; the roster and each hit's disposition in the PR body. If the roster is empty, the PR is the one-line scan widening plus the self-test flip.
- ⛔ Not C (recursive `scripts/**`, an unmeasured area). Surface: `scripts/check-ratchet-remedy-authority.mjs` plus the hit `scripts/pm/*.mjs` files only.
